notesStmt.note: Whitman seems to have written this short poem quickly, to fill out a page, as he was reading and correcting page proofs for November Boughs in June 1888 (see this set of page proof corrections, which includes a very similar, slightly later draft of the poem). Therefore, the present draft almost certainly dates to June 1888.
"Memories" was first published in November Boughs (1888).

lg.head: Memories.
lg.l: How sweet the silent backward tracings!

The wanderings as in dreams! the medi‸tations
of old times resumed—their loves,
joys, persons, voyages!
